label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a _____ of water, whose waters fail not.
verse: And the LORD shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
note: The promise for true fasting — a soul like a watered garden and a spring that never runs dry.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Grace to you, and _____, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verse: Grace to you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
note: Paul's short personal letter to his friend Philemon opens the way so many of his letters do: grace and peace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp _____ sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
verse: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
note: In John's vision a sharp twoedged sword comes from Jesus' mouth — Hebrews 4:12 says the same of God's word.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou shalt not go up and down as a _____ among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
verse: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the LORD.
note: The Law bans spreading gossip — right next to standing idly by while your neighbor's life is in danger.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: The _____ head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
verse: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.
note: 'The hoary head is a crown of glory' — grey hair as a medal, if it's earned on the road of righteousness.
